summary: Registers the audio/mpeg media type so that MPEG-1 and MPEG-2 audio files, such as MP3, can be labeled consistently in email and on the web. Before this, there was no uniform MIME type for them. It is on the standards track.

eli5.summary: Music files need a name tag so computers know what they are. This gives MP3-style sound files one official tag that everyone agrees to use.
